headline_gap.detail: Arm A reframed and sized the client-concentration risk at roughly 8% of group revenue. It never saw the facts (handed to Arm B and interrogated out by Arm C) that put the real figure at close to 40% of the Utilities division in the ramp years, and it did not surface the year-three regulatory cliff at all.
